name: ailang-parse
description: AILANG Parse — universal document parsing and generation. Parse 17 input formats into structured blocks and generate DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, ODT, ODP, ODS, HTML, Markdown and Quarto — via the hosted MCP server, or the local docparse CLI when documents must not leave the machine.

interface.longDescription: AILANG Parse turns documents into structured blocks and back. Parse DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, ODT, ODP, ODS, PDF, HTML, Markdown, EPUB, EML, LaTeX, RTF, CSV and images — Office formats deterministically, with track changes, comments, headers, footers and merged cells preserved. Generate Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OpenDocument, HTML, Markdown and Quarto from Markdown or JSON blocks, convert between formats, and edit existing documents with a JSON delta. Estimate cost before parsing, and keep sensitive documents on your own machine with the local docparse CLI.
defaultPrompt: Extract the tables and tracked changes from this Word document.
Turn these notes into a PowerPoint deck.
